content: Tanvi Saxena follows up with insurance agent Neha Kapoor regarding the reinstatement of her expired auto policy. Neha replies with the total due amount of $542.50 (including a $50 reinstatement fee) and provides payment instructions and available methods via an attached document.

action_items: Pay the total reinstatement amount of $542.50 using credit/debit card or bank transfer following the attached instructions
